negative_results: A REAL_DEVICE mechanical read acquires NOTHING: no accelerometer, microphone, shaker or vibrometer exists here, so RealDevice.acquire raises NoHardwareError and the physical acquisition is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN.
A planted mode at or above the Nyquist frequency is refused (aliasing) before any sample is produced; a folded artifact is never returned as a mode.
A record carrying missing samples (NaN, from a FAULT_INJECTION missing-samples reading) is refused for fitting; a gapped record is not silently fitted.
A spectral feature whose prominence does not clear the noise floor is not a mode: refuse_noise_as_resonance raises, and fit_modal_frequencies returns nothing for a pure-noise record.
Fixture-band modes are attributed to the fixture, not the specimen; fixture motion is never assigned to specimen motion.

A fitted modal frequency, Q and damping ratio are SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION (a fit to synthetic data); a predicted modal frequency is a MODEL_PREDICTION; neither is a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT. refuse_fit_as_measurement, refuse_synthetic_Q_as_device_Q and refuse_prediction_as_measurement all raise.

No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED. The software lane is COMPLETE; the physical mechanical run is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN (blocked_reason is null because all non-physical work is complete).
reopening_test: Reopen the mechanical lane if: a REAL_DEVICE read ever returns samples without physical hardware and a raw artifact; a mode at/above Nyquist is fitted rather than refused; a record with missing samples is fitted; a within-noise spectral feature is classified as a mode; a fixture-band mode is assigned to the specimen; or any fitted/predicted modal value is labelled a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT. The physical acquisition is reopened only by a specimen mounted on a calibrated fixture, driven and captured on a calibrated transducer with a clock binding, an environment log, an immutable raw artifact and an uncertainty budget.
